reason: Right vertical, wrong situation: Scout AI (Sunnyvale, ~37 people) closed a $100M Series A in Apr 2026 — the largest defense-tech Series A in US history, $115M total — on top of $11M in booked DoW contracts, an Army UxS award with a 16-month period of performance and a $150M procurement option (Textron integrating, Edge Case Research validating safety), and evaluation by the 1st Cavalry Division at Fort Hood; Barry's EDP is months-to-field versus funded months remaining where 'one dead transition is often the company,' and that clock does not bind here. They also have a strong sitting technical co-founder CTO (Collin Otis, ex-Director of Autonomy & AI at Kodiak Robotics, Uber ATG), so there is no cleared-senior-technical-leadership vacancy to fill, and they are staffing the government-capture function in-house full-time (Proposal Manager, Senior Program Manager, Director of Business Development - Air Dominance) with Booz Allen Ventures and Decisive Point on the cap table supplying contracting support, which makes his advocacy-chain offer redundant. The one posting that touches his lane — Senior IT Infrastructure & Security Engineer, 'design, build, and operate a secure network and infrastructure that protects CUI data and maintains CMMC Level 2 compliance... our first dedicated networking hire' — is a confession they intend to solve CMMC with a $175-225k full-time senior IC, not a fractional engagement. The five live Mission Operator roles are field-ops individual contributors generic to any robotics company, not evidence of a prototype stalled between demo and fielding. Also above his stated 8-30 headcount band and hiring 27 more roles.
